_approach: One-bar turnaround: the standard groove holds through beat 3, then a short snare pickup (8ths accelerating into 16ths, velocity climbing) plus a crash on the downbeat hands off into the next phrase — a compact version of the genre's build-up vocabulary used every 4 bars rather than only at a drop. Auto-injected into grooves every 4th bar. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
